prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CGI character redesign beauty render for the Looksy desktop creative assistant, a design proof for subsequent 3D modeling and rigging.
Primary request: An original compact optical-surveyor robot with the art direction, sculptural sophistication, material fidelity, lighting and emotional appeal of a leading theatrical animated feature. The current simple vector character must be reimagined as a genuinely dimensional, beautifully crafted CGI character.
Subject: One small curious, intelligent photographic companion. A distinctive unified off-white ceramic/enamel body with a subtly asymmetrical rounded trapezoid silhouette, the mass of a substantial little optical instrument. One principal large dark photographic glass eye set off-center in a recessed sculpted face, with a much smaller auxiliary rangefinder sensor beside it. An articulated upper ceramic eyelid and subtly tilted brow convey focused, slightly mischievous curiosity; eye contact feels alive and thoughtful. Visible depth through layered coated lens elements, an iris and a soft teal catchlight. Compact articulated arms with convincing shoulder, elbow and wrist construction; gently tapered forearms and simple rounded two-finger hands. Short, sturdy legs and broad sculpted feet with soft graphite soles. No thin wire or stick limbs. No separate human-like neck, waist or muscular torso. Graceful intentional asymmetry in stance, believable balance and weight. The character is looking slightly upward toward the viewer, head/body tilted a few degrees with a restrained welcoming gesture, one hand lightly raised and relaxed.
Style/medium: High-end physically based CGI beauty render of an artist-designed, subdivision-modeled film character. Complex flowing solid surfaces and careful bevels; sophisticated topology implied by smooth controlled highlight flow. Tangible ceramic clear coat, satin enamel, finely brushed titanium collars, charcoal elastomer joint bellows, clear multi-element optical glass. Tiny restrained surface imperfections visible only in close highlights. Beautifully resolved contact shadows, interreflections, ambient occlusion in recessed parts, lens reflections with realistic optical depth. Appearance has warmth, charm and real personality without enormous baby eyes or a generic toy robot face.
Composition: One character only, entire full body visible, three-quarter front view, at least 75 percent of image height with ample safe margins around raised hand and feet. Portrait or square composition, camera near the character's eye level, natural 65mm lens perspective. Character tack sharp from head to feet. No panels, no labels, no UI, no typography, no logo.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless dark charcoal studio floor and backdrop, a subtle grounded shadow. Soft large warm key light, cool gentle fill and a carefully placed thin rim; rich dimensional lighting with readable shadows and cinematic tonal control. Neutral warm-white body, graphite joints, very restrained cyan/teal in the optical coating.
Avoid: Flat vector shading, SVG aesthetics, outlines, gradient-painted flat shapes, clip-art, cel shading, voxel/block construction, neon halos, holograms, scanlines, CRT interference, flat screen eyes, overly glossy cheap plastic, crowded sci-fi greebles, weapons, giant antennae, generic smiling monitor-headed robots, copies of established movie characters, any text or watermark.
This is a polished production-design proposal, not an assertion that a 3D rig or animated asset already exists.
